label: Vue 3.5.44 migrated application (vite dev server at http://localhost:5173)

results.action: Open the application without an Admin-Token cookie
results.expected: The login screen is shown and the URL carries the /login route with a redirect query

results.action: Inspect the login form on load
results.expected: The title "vue-admin-template" is shown and username/password are pre-filled with "admin"

results.action: Read the tips line under the login form
results.expected: It advertises "username: admin" and "password: admin"

results.action: Click the eye icon next to the password field
results.expected: The password input switches away from type "password" so the value becomes readable

results.action: Enter the username "nobody" and submit the login form
results.expected: The validation error "Please enter correct username" is shown and the route stays on /login

results.action: Enter a password shorter than 5 characters and submit the login form
results.expected: The validation error "Password cannot be less than 5 characters" is shown

results.action: Submit the pre-filled login form
results.expected: The Admin-Token cookie is written and the dashboard is shown inside the layout shell

results.action: Open /#/login while holding a valid Admin-Token cookie
results.expected: The guard redirects away from the login screen to the dashboard

results.action: Open the dashboard as the authenticated admin
results.expected: The page prints "name:admin" and a roles line

results.action: Inspect the layout shell on the dashboard
results.expected: A 180px dark sidebar (#304156) and a 50px navbar are rendered

results.action: Click the hamburger icon in the navbar
results.expected: The sidebar collapses to 36px and the sidebarStatus cookie becomes 1

results.action: Click the hamburger icon twice
results.expected: The sidebar collapses and then expands back to 180px

results.action: Click the avatar in the navbar
results.expected: A dropdown opens offering "Home" and "LogOut"

results.action: Open the avatar dropdown and click "LogOut"
results.expected: The Admin-Token cookie is removed and the login screen is shown again

results.action: Open the avatar dropdown and click "Home"
results.expected: The application navigates to the dashboard

results.action: Inspect the sidebar entries
results.expected: The sub-menus "Data Management" and "Campus set" are listed and hidden routes are not

results.action: Expand "Campus set" in the sidebar
results.expected: The children "Campus Set List", "Campus Set Add" and "Campus List" are shown

results.action: Expand "Campus set" and click "Campus Set Add"
results.expected: The application navigates to /campusset/add and the add form is shown

results.action: Expand "Data Management" and click "Data Dict"
results.expected: The application navigates to /cmn/list and the dictionary toolbar is shown

results.action: Navigate to /#/campusset/list and read the breadcrumb
results.expected: The breadcrumb starts with "Dashboard" and ends with the plain-text current page

results.action: Navigate from /#/campusset/list to /#/cmn/list
results.expected: The breadcrumb updates to the new route

results.action: Open /#/cmn/list
results.expected: The Export and Import toolbar buttons and the four table columns are shown

results.action: Click the "Import" toolbar button
results.expected: The "Import" dialog opens with the upload button and the 500kb Excel tip

results.action: Open the Import dialog and click "Cancel"
results.expected: The dialog closes again

results.action: Open /#/campusset/list
results.expected: The heading text, both search inputs, the batch delete button and the table columns are shown

results.action: Type a campus name filter on /#/campusset/list
results.expected: The typed value is kept in the search input

results.action: Click "Delete All Chosen Records" with no row selected
results.expected: The confirmation dialog "It will delete all these chosen record." opens with Yes/Cancel

results.action: Open /#/campusset/add
results.expected: The five labelled fields and the Save button are shown

results.action: Fill the campus-set add form
results.expected: All five inputs keep the typed values

results.action: Open /#/campusset/campus/list
results.expected: The State/City selects, the campus filter, both buttons and the table columns are shown

results.action: Open the campus list while the backend is unreachable
results.expected: The table keeps its loading state and the screen still renders the filters

results.action: Open /#/campusset/campus/schedule/1000_0
results.expected: The "Choose:" selection line, the department tree aside and the schedule table are shown

results.action: Open a route that does not exist
results.expected: The 404 screen with "OOPS!" and the "Back to Home" link is shown

results.action: Inspect the URL after requesting an unknown route
results.expected: The catch-all route has redirected the browser to /404
